# spyro nginx

Manage Nginx web server on remote server.

## Before you run it

`nginx status` runs `nginx -t` (sudo on `sudo = true` profiles); `restart`/`reload` need sudo.

Read `spyro profiles` first for hosts and `remote_path`; the `spyro` skill has the safety rules.

## Reference (from `--help`)

### `spyro nginx`

```text
Usage: spyro nginx [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Manage Nginx web server on remote server.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  restart  Restart Nginx.
  sites    List enabled Nginx site configs.
  status   Show Nginx server status.
  version  Show Nginx version.
```

### `spyro nginx restart`

```text
Usage: spyro nginx restart [OPTIONS]

  Restart Nginx.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  --timeout FLOAT     Timeout in seconds (default: 30)
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```
